findings.text: non-blocking: _section_declaration(state, section) duplicates the capability owned by reckon/crew/dispatching/measurement.py:22 _section_declaration(project, slug, *, repo, section) rather than extending it -- same contract (one section's own declaration, resolved through an identity normal form), a second identity function (section_record_id here vs ledger.normalize_section there), and the new copy drops the owner's Mapping declaration-value handling, so a plan whose section_declarations value is a {status: ...} mapping reads as a non-match and the section-open exemption never fires for it.

non-blocking: the sibling case's verdict assertion accepts {None, 'section-open'}, so it also holds when completion reports no impl_move verdict at all, weakening the one assertion that would catch the guard silently skipping the exemption rather than reading the section declaration.
